policy.counts: physical lines of tracked source files
policy.included_paths: tracked active source extensions in LANGS
policy.minimum_product_paths: hcli non-test Python plus crates/*/src and crates/*/shaders, excluding examples, benches and tests
policy.no_gaming: physical lines only; comment stripping, line packing, minification, extension renaming and moving code out of the tree change nothing
policy.test_excluding_rule: exclude test/bench paths and complete Rust items carrying cfg(test)

product_rust_python_composition.scope: minimum-product Rust and Python physical lines selected by is_product

rust_python_composition.scope: all active tracked first-party Rust and Python physical lines

test_excluding_product_rust_python_compo.scope: minimum-product runtime lines after path tests and inline cfg(test) Rust items are excluded

test_excluding_runtime_rust_python_compo.scope: active first-party runtime lines after path tests and inline cfg(test) Rust items are excluded
